posts.text: 22. okt. Steffen Evjen i DNBCarnegie •	(den genierklærte TGS analytiker`n) "TGS - Weak Q3 with underlying EBITDA 7% below consensus, negative FCF and net debt above target levels. Q4 guidance also disappointing, with higher operating costs and limited improvement in utilisation. Consensus 2026 EBITDA estimates expected to fall 5–10%, with larger FCF downgrades. Shares likely to decline at least 5%. Shorts 4 days, CC 8.00 UKTog dagens børsnyheter oppsumert"   -  Så feil kan man ta !
